title: Fees Left Out of a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Redemption During a Reinstatement Period
content:
The company leaves out of a redemption figure on a Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Installment Sale Contract fees it does not collect on a payoff made during a reinstatement period. The fees counted are those posted after the same calendar day twelve months before the quote date, up to and including the quote date, and the amount left out is never more than the fees due balance. Periods are counted in calendar days from the repossession date (not counted).

| Quote date | Fees left out |
|---|---|
| Within a recorded state reinstatement period (any recorded period greater than 0) | returned-payment fees and extension fees posted in the counted twelve months |
| Within the company reinstatement window for the tier, and no state reinstatement period is running | returned-payment fees posted in the counted twelve months |
| Any other day | none |

| Tier | Company reinstatement window (calendar days) |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 5, Tier 4, Tier 3 | 10 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 2, Tier 1 | 15 |
| Kestrel Pre-Owned Retail Tier 1+ | 21 |

### Worked cases (hypothetical quote on 15 June of a year)

- Fees counted: those posted from 16 June of the year before through 15 June. A fee posted on 15 June of the year before is not counted.
- Within a state period, returned-payment fees of $50.00 and an extension fee of $25.00 were posted in the counted months and the fees due balance is $900.00: $75.00 is left out.
- The same fees with a fees due balance of $60.00: $60.00 is left out — never more than the fees due balance.
- Within the company window, no state period running, the same fees: $50.00 is left out.
